missionPremise: A real, confirmed defect (not the WDLL's abstract framing): Dashboards' embed URLs for plan-review and smart-files carried no city-scoping at all -- every city's compose response embedded the identical static origin. Source: dispatch relayed by doc-repo-1d, Nick's direct 'go' authorizing the work in this session.
completionPredicate: Dashboards' live compose response for template-city carries a plan-review/smart-files embed URL naming template-city's own identity; both downstream apps, when loaded with that exact URL, resolve to template-city (not a fabricated match, not a silent default); each of the three products still serves its core standalone flow with no Dashboards origin required.
scopeBasis: The three files/repos the dispatch named (mounts.mjs/compose.mjs, plus the two downstream apps' own city resolution, which the dispatch explicitly called in-scope as 'a small addition on their side too'). Does NOT include fixing staff-review.mjs's separate, dormant, never-called embed-URL builder (a different defect class -- starved, not silently-static) or onboarding a second real city (explicitly out of scope).

prs.ciConclusion: not applicable -- this PR touched only web/app.js, which has no test coverage in this repo's CI; the src/*.test.mjs suite it did NOT touch remains 28/28 passing per the G-107 close

deploys.note: Cloud Run backend NOT redeployed -- this change touched only web/app.js, which server.mjs does not serve (confirmed by grep before skipping the Cloud Run deploy).
Cloud Run backend NOT redeployed, same reasoning.

liveVerification.item1: GET https://smartcity-dashboards-52ecsl5mvq-ue.a.run.app/api/lenses/city-manager/compose?cityKey=template-city (production, post-traffic-shift) returns planReview.url=https://plan-review-app-ten.vercel.app/?embed=1&cityKey=template-city and smartFiles.url=https://smart-files-app.vercel.app/?embed=1&cityKey=template-city -- both carry the composing city's own identity, not a bare static origin.
liveVerification.crossCityDifferentiation: No second city pack is registered in production (GET /api/city-packs returns []; onboarding one is explicitly out of scope). Proven instead at the unit level: compose.test.mjs's new test calls composeCityManager with two different cityKeys against identical env and asserts the two resulting URLs differ and each carries its own cityKey.
liveVerification.item2_standaloneIndependence: All four standalone surfaces confirmed live and healthy with no cityKey, no embed param, no Dashboards referrer: plan-review-app-ten.vercel.app (200), smart-files-app.vercel.app (200), the plan-review Cloud Run backend (200), the smart-files Cloud Run backend (200).
liveVerification.genuineEndToEndClosure: Rather than stop at 'the compose response looks right' and 'the downstream logic looks right' as two separate claims, fetched the ACTUAL deployed app.js/index.html from both Vercel production URLs and loaded them in jsdom with the EXACT URL the live compose response produces. smart-files-app: persona <select> resolves to template-city/g71-calendar -- confirmed against the real deployed file, not a local copy. plan-review: localStorage pr_persona resolves to template-city/staff -- same. This closes the gap between 'each half is individually correct' and 'the two halves actually compose correctly in production', which is the entire point of a presentation-convergence card.

item3_independentSkus.SCOS-PLAN-DEP: plan-review. Confirmed standalone: serves its own Cloud Run backend (plan-review-ozx33wafia-ue.a.run.app) and Vercel front (plan-review-app-ten.vercel.app) directly; this card's change makes it OPTIONALLY read a cityKey param when embedded, and falls back to its prior standalone default when it isn't. It does not require Dashboards to be reachable, running, or even to exist.
item3_independentSkus.SCOS-FILE-DEP: smart-files. Same shape: own Cloud Run backend (smart-files-padrd77ava-ue.a.run.app) and Vercel front (smart-files-app.vercel.app), optional cityKey param, honest fallback. Does not require Dashboards.
item3_independentSkus.SCOS-DASH-DEP: smartcity-dashboards. Requires plan-review's and smart-files' PUBLIC embed origins to be reachable (to mount them as iframes) -- it has always required this, per G-13's consumer-contract ruling that iframe embed is accepted. This card does not add or remove that dependency; it only makes the URL Dashboards constructs for those iframes carry the composing city's identity. Dashboards continues to require the other two; the other two do not require Dashboards.
item3_independentSkus.conclusion: None of the three now requires another BEYOND the pre-existing, already-accepted direction (Dashboards embeds the other two as iframes; the other two never call back into Dashboards). This card did not change that dependency direction -- it fixed what Dashboards puts IN the iframe src, not whether the iframe relationship exists at all.

constraintsHonored: Worktree isolation maintained across all three repos given this session's own G-108/G-109/G-113 collision history on plan-review's shared worktree.
Base-freshness verified before every push and merge; one real drift caught (plan-review gained G-113 mid-lane) and merged cleanly with a full re-test, not force-pushed over.
Merged only on the literal CI conclusion string SUCCESS via gh --json, on all three PRs that had CI.

Verify a check by violating it, twice: the standalone-vs-embedded persona-defaulting distinction was caught by a failing isolated-logic test before it ever reached a PR, not found by review after the fact; the false-alarm on smart-files-app's Vercel deploy (looked missing, was actually just edge-cache propagation lag) was investigated to a real root cause rather than reported as a failure.
No scope creep: staff-review.mjs's dormant, uncalled embed-URL functions were investigated, confirmed inert, and explicitly left alone rather than "fixed" for a defect they cannot actually cause.
No second city onboarded, per explicit out-of-scope instruction; cross-city proof done at the unit level instead.
whatRemainsOpen: staff-review.mjs's planReviewIframeSrc/smartFilesIframeSrc: dormant, uncalled code implementing the identical (unfixed) static-URL pattern. Not a live defect today since nothing invokes it, but worth a retirement or a wiring decision by whoever owns that file, so it doesn't get wired up later still carrying the pre-G-114 shape.

The genuine end-to-end jsdom check on plan-review only confirmed the persona-resolution half (localStorage), not the full rendered page text, because the test harness's blanket fetch-stub aborted the render before reaching that screen. Not believed to indicate a real defect (the actual fix logic was confirmed), but a more careful harness (mocking only the specific endpoints render() needs) would close this fully if ever revisited.
